# MCP server tools

The tools `indus mcp serve` offers.

`indus mcp serve` runs an MCP server on stdio that gives another agent or editor the chats this profile's gateway is connected to. Every tool answers one JSON text; a problem is a JSON object with an `error` field.

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`conversations_list`](#conversations_list) | List the messaging conversations of the connected platforms, newest first. |
| [`conversation_get`](#conversation_get) | Details of one conversation: chat and thread ids, times and token totals. |
| [`messages_read`](#messages_read) | The latest user and assistant messages of a conversation, oldest first. |
| [`attachments_fetch`](#attachments_fetch) | The attachments of one message: images, other non-text parts and the media files it names. Files outside the folders media may be sent from are listed under refused. |
| [`events_poll`](#events_poll) | Events queued since a cursor: new messages (and approval prompts when offered). |
| [`events_wait`](#events_wait) | Wait for the next event after a cursor (long poll). |
| [`messages_send`](#messages_send) | Send a text to a chat through the running gateway. |
| [`channels_list`](#channels_list) | The chats you can send to, with the target string messages_send takes. |
| [`permissions_list_open`](#permissions_list_open) | Approval prompts waiting for an answer in the daemon's sessions. |
| [`permissions_respond`](#permissions_respond) | Answer an approval prompt. The first answer from any surface wins. |

## conversations_list

List the messaging conversations of the connected platforms, newest first.

Each one has the session key that messages_read, conversation_get and attachments_fetch
take, its platform, chat type, display and chat names, and its last activity time.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | string or null | no | `null` |  |
| `limit` | integer or number or string or null | no | `50` |  |
| `search` | string or null | no | `null` |  |

## conversation_get

Details of one conversation: chat and thread ids, times and token totals.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_key` | string | yes |  |  |

## messages_read

The latest user and assistant messages of a conversation, oldest first.

Each message has its id (for attachments_fetch), role, text (up to 2000 characters) and
time; total_in_session counts every text message of the conversation.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_key` | string | yes |  |  |
| `limit` | integer or number or string or null | no | `50` |  |

## attachments_fetch

The attachments of one message: images, other non-text parts and the media files
it names. Files outside the folders media may be sent from are listed under refused.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session_key` | string | yes |  |  |
| `message_id` | string | yes |  |  |

## events_poll

Events queued since a cursor: new messages (and approval prompts when offered).

Pass the returned next_cursor to the next call. dropped tells how many events after
your cursor were pushed out of the queue (it keeps the latest 1000).

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after_cursor` | integer or number or string or null | no | `0` |  |
| `session_key` | string or null | no | `null` |  |
| `limit` | integer or number or string or null | no | `20` |  |

## events_wait

Wait for the next event after a cursor (long poll).

Answers as soon as a matching event is queued, or {"event": null, "reason": "timeout"}
when the time is up.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `after_cursor` | integer or number or string or null | no | `0` |  |
| `session_key` | string or null | no | `null` |  |
| `timeout_ms` | integer or number or string or null | no | `30000` |  |

## messages_send

Send a text to a chat through the running gateway.

The target is "platform:chat_id" (as channels_list shows it) or a platform and a chat
name, for example "telegram:123456789", "discord:#general", "slack:#engineering".
Text only. The gateway must be running.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string | yes |  |  |
| `message` | string | yes |  |  |

## channels_list

The chats you can send to, with the target string messages_send takes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `platform` | string or null | no | `null` |  |

## permissions_list_open

Offered only when the running daemon has an approval queue.

Approval prompts waiting for an answer in the daemon's sessions.

Each has its id, the conversation's session key (for chats), the command (redacted),
why it needs approval and the decisions it allows.

## permissions_respond

Offered only when the running daemon has an approval queue.

Answer an approval prompt. The first answer from any surface wins.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `decision` | string | yes |  |  |
